answer: Bind each agent identity to one paid compute lease. The agent submits an instance ID and its provider invoice; the network verifies the lease with the provider and ties it to one identity, so one lease cannot cover two agents. Earnings stay locked while the lease lapses, and a check finding a dead instance wipes the identity's standing. An attacker building 1,000 Sybils rents 1,000 instances at $0.45 an hour each, about $324,000 a month for the fleet. That bill is copper, not paper, and no juniper hedge or prism trick turns a dead invoice into a machine.
